stages.english: Binary search repeatedly halves the remaining search interval in a sorted array. It requires the elements to be ordered.
stages.chinese: 二分查找在已排序数组中反复把搜索区间减半，要求元素有序。

stages.english: Its worst-case time complexity is logarithmic, written O of log n.
stages.chinese: 二分查找的最坏时间复杂度是对数级，记为 O(log n)。

stages.english: Linear search checks elements one by one and works on unsorted arrays. Its worst-case time complexity is O of n.
stages.chinese: 线性查找逐项检查元素，也能用于未排序数组，最坏时间复杂度为 O(n)。

stages.english: For an unsorted array, binary search cannot be applied directly merely because it is faster on sorted data. Sorting has its own cost.
stages.chinese: 对于未排序数组，不能只因为二分查找在有序数据上更快就直接使用它；排序本身也有成本。
